summary: Ubuntu 25.10 (Questing Quokka) was released on 9 October 2025. Features: latest GNOME and kernel, continued refinements to App Center and package management. The quokka is an Australian marsupial known for its smile; 'questing' suggests exploration. Final interim before 26.04 LTS Resolute Raccoon.
notes: Standard support until 2026-07-09. Interim release bridging to the next LTS.
